notes.title: [another] Update!
notes.content:
Due to the heavy requests of more export features, we've added the following to yet another update:

1. You can now export a group, or entire palette to the following formats:

*.aco (photoshop)
*.png
*.gpl (gimp)

You do this by clicking the "e" button in the group or top bar section.

2.  We've also added  the ability to grab a color from a gradient between 2 hex codes.  

This is found in the drop list menu at the bottom (gradient).  You can then copy 2 hex codes into the text boxes to create a gradient and click to select any color in between the two.


We're still looking to hear more of what you're looking for in Swatcher!  Other export formats, functions, etc.

Let us know is the discussions area!

notes.title: Updates (and fixes)!
notes.content:
We're rolling out a new update that has a couple of highly requested features for everyone!

- You can now export your saved group colors, or all saved colors as an *.aco format (photoshop)

- You can now import an image and use an eyedropper to pick colors

- [i](bugfix: when deleting a color in a group, the "delete color" icon (x in the top corner) now stays with it's original color)[/i]

We've also uploaded a new video tutorial on how to use these new features.

Let us know what else you'd like to see in future updates!

- Frozen Flame Software Team
